Advisory U.S. Department of Transportation Administration Federal Aviation Circular AC Ne: 00-4411 Date: May 1997

Subject: STATUS OF FEDERAL AVIATION REGULATIONS

1. PURPOSE.

This circular provides the public with the current publication status of the loose-leaf Federal Aviation Regulations, prices, and order form. This Advisory Circular will be updated later this year because ofthe frequent changes.

2. CANCELLATION.

AC 00-44HH, dated August 1996, is cancelled.

3. HOW TO ORDER.

a. Enclosed is an order form. one section for subscription orders and the other for publication orders. b. Appendix 1 lists the parts sold as publication orders (single-sale basis); Appendix 2 lists the parts sold as subscription orders. The Special Federal Aviation ReguJa. tions (SFAR) which are presently in effect are included in their related parts. The listing ofSFARs is included in this Advisory Circular as Appendix 3. Because oftheir infrequent changes the following parts have recently been moved over to single sale: Parts 36, 43, 45, 103, 137, 139, 150 and 161. Part 16 is new and is- also available for single sale. c. Federal A viati.on Regulations are sold by the Superintendent of Documents-. Parts having frequent changes are sold on subscription ( use subscription section of form). Parts which are changed less frequently are sold on a single-sale basis and changes to these parts are sold separately (use publication section of form). d. Mail your order forms- to Superintendent of Documents-, P.O. Box 371954, Pitts-burgh. PA 15250-7954. Direct any questions you may have to the Order and Information Desk at (202) 512-1800. John H. Cassady Deputy Chief Counsel Initiated by: AGC-200
